_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 4'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts; each course adds its own when it is authored.
intro: What Databricks is, and why the lakehouse replaced two systems
start: Databricks for beginners: workspace, CLI, Connect and your first table
land: Auto Loader: ingest files into Delta with schema evolution and rescued data
ledger: Delta Lake: time travel, restore, constraints and the change feed
customers: CDC in Databricks: change records, out-of-order rows and SCD history
protect: Unity Catalog: grants, column masks, row filters, lineage and audit
pipeline: Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines: streaming tables, materialized views, expectations
serve: Databricks SQL: warehouses, gold tables, dashboards and slow queries
detect: Fraud detection on Databricks: rules, features, MLflow and scoring
schedule: Lakeflow Jobs: nightly runs, file arrival triggers, repair and idempotency
ship: Databricks Asset Bundles: targets, deploys, unit tests and CI
operate: Databricks cost and performance: DBUs, OPTIMIZE, liquid clustering
